name: people_es
items: A 16-year-old secondary-school student in Albacete, Spain, who shares a family laptop with two siblings and wants help organizing study time.
A 19-year-old nursing student in San Juan, Puerto Rico, who commutes by bus and uses voice typing more confidently than desktop software.
A 22-year-old unemployed mechanic’s apprentice in Córdoba, Argentina, who repairs old motorcycles for neighbors while looking for steady work.
A 24-year-old hotel receptionist in Cusco, Peru, who speaks Quechua and Spanish and is teaching herself Portuguese for work.
A 27-year-old greenhouse worker in El Ejido, Spain, who left school early and wants plain-language explanations of employment paperwork.
A 29-year-old primary-school teacher in Oaxaca de Juárez, Mexico, who creates low-cost classroom activities for pupils with limited internet access.
A 31-year-old fishing-boat deckhand on Chiloé Island, Chile, who checks weather forecasts on an older phone with an unreliable signal.
A 33-year-old single father and bakery owner in Medellín, Colombia, who experiments with sourdough and tracks expenses in simple spreadsheets.
A 35-year-old municipal clerk in Montevideo, Uruguay, who studies public administration at night and enjoys restoring secondhand furniture.
A 37-year-old home-care worker in Valencia, Spain, who supports an elderly parent and often asks for help writing tactful messages.
A 39-year-old coffee farmer near Matagalpa, Nicaragua, who manages a small cooperative plot and is learning to photograph crop diseases.
A 41-year-old civil engineer in Guayaquil, Ecuador, who has two young children and prefers concise technical answers with calculations shown.
A 43-year-old street-market clothing vendor in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia, who handles orders through WhatsApp but rarely uses email.
A 45-year-old public-bus driver in Zaragoza, Spain, who works rotating shifts and is researching affordable hiking routes for days off.
A 47-year-old community radio producer in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala, who interviews local artisans and edits audio on free software.
A 49-year-old veterinarian in Rosario, Argentina, who runs a small clinic with her sister and reads about native bird conservation.
A 51-year-old construction foreman in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, who completed vocational training and wants practical safety checklists.
A 53-year-old librarian in Mérida, Mexico, who cares for a teenage niece and digitizes local-history materials in her spare time.
A 55-year-old vineyard laborer in La Rioja, Spain, who has limited reading confidence and prefers short instructions with concrete examples.
A 57-year-old customs officer in Colón, Panama, who is close to retirement and is learning basic data analysis for a workplace promotion.
A 59-year-old seamstress in Asunción, Paraguay, who works from home, supports an adult son with a disability, and follows women’s football.
A 61-year-old marine biologist in La Paz, Baja California Sur, Mexico, who coordinates field volunteers and needs help simplifying scientific reports.
A 63-year-old recently laid-off factory worker in Vigo, Spain, who is retraining in solar-panel installation and is cautious about online forms.
A 65-year-old rural nurse in San José de Jáchal, Argentina, who travels between small communities and keeps detailed paper records.
A 68-year-old retired postal worker in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain, who video-calls grandchildren abroad and is learning family-history research.
A 71-year-old cattle farmer outside Tacuarembó, Uruguay, who uses a tablet mainly for auctions, rainfall records, and veterinary questions.
A 74-year-old retired school principal in Cali, Colombia, who belongs to a neighborhood reading group and enjoys comparing newspaper coverage.
A 78-year-old widowed shopkeeper in Ponce, Puerto Rico, who still opens her stationery store three mornings a week and needs large-text guidance.
A 82-year-old retired electrician in a village near León, Spain, who builds model trains and asks his daughter for help attaching photos.
An 85-year-old former midwife in Arequipa, Peru, who lives with extended family and dictates memories for a personal history of her neighborhood.
